statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116331 (PostgreSQL min/max aggregate type confusion executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for major version 16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116331/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/63b204d9f9c6d590845cdb18aa4dc69858c21647, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116331", is contained in the REL_16_16 tag and not in REL_16_15, and changes fetch_agg_sort_op() in src/backend/optimizer/plan/planagg.c so that the planner ignores an aggregate's sort operator, and so does not build a MinMaxAggPath, unless the aggregate takes a single argument whose type equals its result type; it changes no other file. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116331 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the C source files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql16 at 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0. The vulnerable code is in the server planner, usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, which the postgresql16 package ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 16.16-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) it reports that older 16.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 16.16, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116331 (type confusion in the min/max aggregate optimization lets an object creator execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the server) in 17.12 on the 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116331/. Checked every published build of this owner on amd64 and arm64: the server binary in 17.12-0 and in the build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12, which contains the fix; the earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the build of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, report PostgreSQL 17.11 and are affected.
